description: This file defines the TimesheetPeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler class which implements an interface to determine if the timesheet period is defined, and whether the user should be directed to define it. It manages configuration service dependencies and contains logic to enable functionality based on timesheet period status.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler
classes.description: Class responsible for enabling the homepage feature based on whether the timesheet period is defined, implementing HomePageEnablerInterface.

methods.name: getConfigService
methods.description: Lazy initializer for the ConfigService instance, creating it if not already set.

methods.name: setConfigService
methods.description: Setter for injecting a ConfigService dependency.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the homepage should be enabled by checking if the timesheet period is undefined; throws CoreServiceException if service fails.
